source_inspection.softmax_execution: one CUDA thread performs max, exp, sum and normalization

inspection: The 8K prompt itself completed. The mandatory post-prefill decode increased T from 8192 to 8193 and was rejected by the explicit native guard before a kernel launch. CUDA and nvidia-smi remained healthy after close. This is a fail-closed context-capacity limit, not OOM, numerical divergence or recurrence of H014-027v.
bottleneck: The batch-1 MLA kernel retains the complete T-element score vector in dynamic shared memory and serializes softmax on thread 0. The wrapper has no opt-in shared-memory capacity check or launch configuration above T=8192.
decision: RETAIN the failed receipt and the 8192 guard in the certified H014-030d binary. Do not claim 8K+decode or 16K prefill support from this binary.
redesign: H014-033c will query the actual per-block opt-in shared-memory limit, opt in only when the requested allocation fits, and incrementally retest 1K, 4K, 8K and 16K with exact safe-fixture, CUDA-health and sm_86 lineage gates.
